entries.visual_description_en: recognizable QBZ-95 style bullpup service rifle, compact integrated rear receiver, magazine clearly behind the primary grip, raised carry-handle silhouette

required_landmarks_en: curved magazine visibly behind the primary grip
rear receiver and shoulder contact merged into one compact shell
raised upper bridge with a transparent gap beneath it
short rear body with a distinct forward barrel and fore-end
confusable_exclusions_en: not a conventional rifle with the magazine ahead of the grip
not an AUG or generic science-fiction bullpup
no separate long shoulder stock behind the receiver

entries.visual_description_en: recognizable M4A1 style conventional carbine, telescoping rear stock, magazine ahead of the primary grip, straight top rail and compact handguard

required_landmarks_en: compact collapsible polymer stock attached by a visible buffer tube
box magazine visibly ahead of the primary grip
low flat receiver rail without a permanent carry-handle loop
short carbine handguard and barrel rather than a full-length rifle front
confusable_exclusions_en: not an M16 with a full fixed stock or permanent carry handle
not an MP5 with twin bare sliding stock rails
not an AK or Type 81 with a strongly curved magazine and raised gas tube

entries.visual_description_en: recognizable Type 81 style conventional long rifle, fixed rear stock, strongly curved magazine ahead of the grip, long barrel and raised gas-tube line

required_landmarks_en: solid fixed shoulder stock
strongly curved magazine ahead of the grip with a visible gap from the trigger guard
front sight set back with an exposed barrel section continuing to the muzzle
long fore-end and raised gas-tube line above the receiver
confusable_exclusions_en: not a generic AK-47 or Type 56 with the magazine tight against the trigger guard
not an M4 with a collapsible stock and flat top rail

entries.visual_description_en: recognizable M16A2 style full-length conventional service rifle, fixed solid rear stock, straight magazine ahead of the primary grip, permanent raised carry handle and long ribbed fore-end

visual_axes.stock_profile: full fixed triangular polymer shoulder stock
visual_axes.upper_landmark: permanent raised carry handle with an open gap beneath it
visual_axes.magazine_profile: straight box magazine ahead of the primary grip
visual_axes.fore_end_profile: full-length ribbed rifle handguard and long barrel
visual_axes.receiver_profile: long AR-pattern upper and lower receiver with fixed carry handle

required_landmarks_en: full fixed triangular shoulder stock rather than a collapsible carbine stock
permanent raised carry-handle loop with a visible open gap
straight box magazine visibly ahead of the primary grip
long ribbed fore-end and full-length exposed barrel
confusable_exclusions_en: not an M4A1 with a telescoping stock, short handguard, or low flat top rail
not an AK-pattern rifle with a curved magazine and raised gas tube

entries.visual_description_en: recognizable QSZ-92 style compact service pistol, short slide above a single grip, magazine housed inside the grip, no shoulder stock

required_landmarks_en: compact service-pistol slide above one grip
magazine contained inside the primary grip and no shoulder stock
large rounded trigger guard rather than a squared Glock-style guard
short frame and accessory-rail projection beneath the front of the barrel
confusable_exclusions_en: not a Glock silhouette with a squared trigger guard and blocky rectangular frame
not a machine pistol or stocked handgun
